body.purpose: Human-facing labels, instructions, and explanatory copy.

shadows.name: pop

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action on a page or in a dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); padding: 0 14px; background: var(--accent, #7cc7ff); color: #06131f; font: 500 13px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent2, #a3d8ff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent, #7cc7ff); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 34px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(148 166 196 / 0.14)); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); padding: 0 14px; background: var(--panel2, #131a26); color: var(--ink, #e8edf5); font: 500 13px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--line2, rgb(148 166 196 / 0.28)); background: var(--panel3, #1a2330); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--panel, #0e131c); }

components.name: Terminal Input
components.description: A compact field embedded in a rack surface.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 220px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(148 166 196 / 0.14)); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); padding: 0 12px; background: var(--panel, #0e131c); color: var(--ink, #e8edf5); font: 400 13px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line2, rgb(148 166 196 / 0.28)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rack Panel
components.description: A bounded content surface separated by tone and a hairline seam.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 280px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(148 166 196 / 0.14)); border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 12px); padding: 16px; background: var(--panel, #0e131c); color: var(--ink, #e8edf5); font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: var(--line2, rgb(148 166 196 / 0.28)); } .ds-panel:focus-within { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-panel-label { margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--ink3, #7a87a0); font: 600 10px/1.2 "JetBrains Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; }

components.name: Tracking Lamp
components.description: A semantic status lamp that never appears without its label.
components.css: .ds-lamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink2, #a9b5c8); font: 400 12px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lamp:hover { color: var(--ink, #e8edf5); } .ds-lamp:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-lamp-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ok, #6fe3a3); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); }

components.name: Instrument Readout
components.description: A silkscreen label over one real tabular measurement.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; color: var(--ink, #e8edf5); font: 400 13px/1.25 "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-readout:hover strong { color: var(--accent, #7cc7ff); } .ds-readout:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-readout-label { color: var(--ink3, #7a87a0); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Compact rack navigation with one ice-blue active edge.
components.html: DEVICESSESSIONSAUDIT
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; height: 36px; background: var(--panel, #0e131c); } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--ink3, #7a87a0); text-decoration: none; font: 600 10px "JetBrains Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--panel3, #1a2330); color: var(--ink, #e8edf5); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-active { border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #7cc7ff); background: var(--panel2, #131a26); color: var(--ink, #e8edf5); }

components.name: Security Mode Badge
components.description: Persistent truthful disclosure of transport and end-to-end security.
components.html: TLS RELAYNOT E2EE
components.css: .ds-security { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(148 166 196 / 0.14)); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 8px; background: var(--panel2, #131a26); color: var(--ink2, #a9b5c8); font: 600 10px "JetBrains Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-security:hover { border-color: var(--line2, rgb(148 166 196 / 0.28)); } .ds-security:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7cc7ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-security svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: var(--ok, #6fe3a3); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-security strong { color: var(--warn, #ffb454); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Remote Terminal behaves like a precision observatory control room: the home machine is the tracked instrument, the relay is the dome link, and the terminal is the eyepiece. Deep blue-black rack faces, hairline seams, measured spacing, and compact readouts communicate control without imitating a generic dark developer tool. The visual system is restrained rather than sterile. One ice-blue accent owns interaction; green, amber, and red are reserved for live instrument state. The light theme becomes a warm day logbook, while high contrast preserves the same hierarchy with stronger seams. Typography separates human-facing instructions from machine measurements instead of turning every surface into monospace costume.
keyCharacteristics: Precision rack geometry with quiet tonal layers and hairline seams.
Instrument lamps and readouts whose state remains legible without color.
Dense, keyboard-first operation around a dominant terminal viewport.
Self-hosted typography and assets; no decorative network dependency.
Responsive continuity: desktop instrument rail becomes a five-position mobile dock.

rules.name: The One Signal Channel Rule
rules.body: Ice blue means interaction; green, amber, and red mean state. Never exchange those responsibilities.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: A status color must have a visible label or accessible name; color never carries the state alone.

rules.name: The Monospace Earns Its Place Rule
rules.body: Use JetBrains Mono only where alignment or machine identity communicates useful information.

rules.name: The Rack Plane Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces do not float. If a panel can be separated with tone and a seam, do not add a shadow.

dos: Do reserve interaction ice for focus, selection, and decisive actions.
Do pair every lamp and semantic color with text or an accessible name.
Do keep PTY measurements tabular and human guidance in the sans stack.
Do remove secondary telemetry before allowing critical controls or security state to overflow on small screens.
Do preserve mounted terminals across route switches, pane zoom, and split resizing.
donts: Don't introduce black-and-neon hacker styling, generic SaaS gradient cards, or decorative terminal gibberish.
Don't use rounded floating cards for persistent rack chrome.
Don't turn ordinary prose into uppercase monospace labels.
Don't use green for primary actions or ice blue for health state.
Don't add shadows where a tonal step and hairline seam already establish hierarchy.
